title: Boar meat
content:
# Boar meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: RawMeat | Source: Boar | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Boar meat is a basic food obtained by killing Boars.
It can be cooked on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station to obtain Cooked boar meat, or Coal if overcooked.

## Availability

• Creature: Boar | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

### Crafting

Cooked boar meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Boar meat as ingredient, or vice versa.

• Result: Cooked boar meat( Coal) | Ingredients: • Boar meat x1 | Crafting Station: Cooking stationor Iron cooking station

• Result: Minced meat sauce | Ingredients: • Boar meat x1• Neck tail x1• Carrot x1 | Crafting Station: Cauldron (1)

• Result: Boar jerky | Ingredients: • Boar meat x1• Honey x1 | Crafting Station: Cauldron (1)

• Result: Sausages x4 | Ingredients: • Entrails x4• Boar meat x1• Thistle x1 | Crafting Station: Cauldron (2)

• Result: Turnip stew | Ingredients: • Boar meat x1• Turnip x3 | Crafting Station: Cauldron (2)

• Result: Whole roasted Meadow boar | Ingredients: • Cooked deer meat x2• Cooked boar meat x5• Dandelion x4• Woodland herb blend x1 | Crafting Station: Food preparation table

Categorias: Materials, Food
